scope: finite real rank-one packet family with analytic momentum-dependent weights; not a full Pati-Salam loop calculation

setup.packetFamily: G(z)=sum_i w_i(z) u_i u_i^T, with u_i=(d_i,y_i)^T
setup.protectedFunctionalIdeal: det G(z)=0 on an open connected analytic momentum domain

exactIdentity.functionalCriterion: the coefficient vector (Delta_ij^2) lies in the kernel of the linear map sending coefficients to sum coefficients times w_i w_j
exactIdentity.independentProductCorollary: if the active product functions w_i w_j are linearly independent, interval protection forces every active Delta_ij=0

oneLoopTangency.criterion: D_1 is identically zero on the analytic domain
oneLoopTangency.independentFormFactorCorollary: if the f_alpha are linearly independent, every loop vector is absent or projectively aligned with the tree vector
oneLoopTangency.sameSignCorollary: if all nonzero f_alpha have one sign on the interval, pointwise cancellation is impossible for real vectors unless every active Delta_0alpha vanishes

pointVersusInterval.analyticFact: a nonzero analytic determinant has isolated zeros; cancellation at one momentum does not imply interval closure
pointVersusInterval.derivativeTest: interval closure is equivalent to all Taylor coefficients, or all derivatives at one interior point, vanishing
stableMechanisms: a symmetry-enforced functional dependence placing the squared-minor vector in the form-factor nullspace

physicalConnection.claim1512TreeResult: the bounded masked minimal Pati-Salam census has one retained tree column
physicalConnection.newRequirement: inventory every loop topology, its endpoint coupling vector, mass threshold, and form factor
physicalConnection.killTest: one admitted transverse loop vector with a form factor not in an exact Ward-enforced null relation destroys interval protection at one loop
physicalConnection.nonClaim: the present evidence does not establish which loop packets occur in the physical family-extended Pati-Salam carrier

verdict: momentum dependence upgrades common-ray alignment to a functional-rank condition; a zero at one momentum is not protection over an interval
